user_prompt: I need to pull together our current payroll structure and benefit allocations for the upcoming fiscal review, and at the same time, I need to log and track some equipment upgrades we're rolling out across departments to stay audit-ready. Can you help me access both of those workflows in a single request?

steps.step_name: I need to access and review our current payroll structure and benefit allocations for the upcoming fiscal review.
I need to log and track equipment upgrades being rolled out across departments to maintain audit readiness.

intent_resolver.reason: The user is requesting two separate, distinct workflows (payroll/benefits review and equipment upgrade tracking) that don't form a single cohesive process; proc_018 covers compensation review but no skill covers equipment upgrade lifecycle management end-to-end.

sub_queries: Pull together our current payroll structure and benefit allocations for the upcoming fiscal review
Log and track equipment upgrades we're rolling out across departments to stay audit-ready
